author: ETA PRIME
description:
With Microsoft's new Xbox mode rolling out, you can now turn your laptop, mini PC, or tablet directly into an Xbox console! In this video, we're taking a look at the new Windows 11 Xbox Mode updates, including how to enable it, customize the Game Bar, and seamlessly add games from Steam and external drives to your library.   

https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2026/04/30/xbox-mode-pc-windows-11/

We also test out the new built-in task switcher, allowing you to move freely between multiple games on the fly, just like Quick Resume on a console! I’m testing this out on the OneXPlayer Super V tablet featuring the Core Ultra 358H and the new B390i GPU to see how it handles app switching between titles like Cyberpunk 2077 and Cosmic Invasion.
